recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes an approved non-substantive correction in an active Patient example without changing conformance behavior or unrelated content.
issue_request: FHIR-48914 was an Applied/Persuasive PA change request asking that the Patient sex-and-gender example use the patient's stated she/her pronouns in recorded sex or gender comments, replacing "their" with "her".
initial_application: Commit 4c1237958ab03cef21fd2847617f86150b6c0c85, merged by fa21bc7973866b7537e69c75267c20a1ae388caa, partially applied the issue by changing only the insurance-card comment. The same active example still had birth-certificate and driver's-license comments using "their".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Patient as an active resource, and source/patient/list-Patient-examples.xml includes Patient/patient-example-sex-and-gender as the Transgender Person Example. PA 2025-09-09 minutes record that FHIR-48914 would be fixed as suggested by the reporter with a 3-0-0 approval. Searches found no conflicting or superseding core decision.
reconciliation: Updated source/patient/patient-example-sex-and-gender.xml so the birth-certificate and driver's-license recorded-sex/gender comments say "her" instead of "their", matching the already-updated insurance-card comment and the example's pronoun extension.
source_changes: source/patient/patient-example-sex-and-gender.xml: changed the birth-certificate and driver's-license recorded-sex/gender comment values from "their" to "her".
